title: Acute infero-postero-lateral MI | Health Education Assets Library (HEAL)
description: Hyperacute ST segment elevation is seen in leads II, III, aVF (inferior location) and in leads V4-6  (apical lateral wall location).  Hyperacute ST depression is seen in leads V1-2 (an expression of posterior wall injury).  in addition there are reciprocal ST segment depression changes in leads I and aVL.
